quarterly_data.signal: September 2026 monthly revenue (MOPS filing): consolidated net revenue NT$6,517,771 thousand, up 27.27% YoY (September 2025: NT$5,121,166 thousand). January-September 2026 revenue NT$40,414,168 thousand, up 18.43% YoY (same period of 2025: NT$34,124,996 thousand). The filing notes that year-to-date revenue is translated at the annual average exchange rate and monthly revenue at that month's average rate, so the monthly figures do not sum to the year-to-date total.
